propositions: completion.py (800 LOC) and completion_recovery.py (799 LOC) exceed the module-size CI cap and require decomposition along architectural concern boundaries rather than mechanical splitting.

completion.py contains four distinct concerns: operation orchestration, deterministic child-closure gate, epic-close bug-screen logic, and verdict reconciliation; these must separate into four modules while preserving public __all__ facade for backward compatibility.

completion_recovery.py contains three concerns: criteria surface/admission bounds, failure taxonomy, and recovery orchestration; these must separate into three modules while re-exporting documented entry points.

All moved symbols must remain patchable at their current import paths by maintaining re-export seams in the original modules, and every monkeypatch/patch target in tests must be enumerated and repointed.
Refactor is behavior-preserving with zero assertion changes; only import paths and monkeypatch targets update; existing test suites validate correctness unchanged.
